title: One Stuck Ship Held Up $9 Billion of Goods a Day for 6 Days

scenes.text: One stuck ship held up 9 billion dollars a day.
The Ever Given ran aground in the Suez Canal on March 23rd, 2021.
It's 400 metres long, and strong winds in a sandstorm pushed it off course.
Soon more than 400 ships were stuck waiting.
Diggers scooped sand from beneath it, tugboats pulled, and crews removed thousands of tonnes of ballast water.
After six days, it floated free.
One ship, six days, and the whole world felt it.

description:
On March 23rd, 2021, the 400-metre Ever Given got stuck in the Suez Canal, blocking it for about six days.
Estimates put the goods held up at around 9 billion dollars a day.
How much do you think it cost the world?
first_comment: What was the last thing you ordered that got delayed?
